answer: The gale schedule is applied in atlas and nectar shows each instalment. Someone therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split which means 49% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4108 identities would post 2937 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
